services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its listed inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 18.9 on 31 October 2026, it is above its five-year norm; it eased slightly from 19.2 a month earlier but remains up from 16.8 three months ago and -22.1 six months ago. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative (-6.7).

products.text: Products Pulse combines weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 36.7 in November 2026, it is above its five-year norm and has risen from 29.4 three months earlier and 10.7 six months earlier. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the biggest negative contributor (-8.7); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT retail sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -14.4 in November 2026, it is below its five-year norm, improving from -24.1 three months earlier but down from 24.9 a year earlier; fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive contributor (+5.9) and inverted AUD/USD the biggest negative (-20.2). Tungsten policy flags are excluded until sufficient history is available.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 6 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 4 commissioned cells, with $7.2 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised where stated. Over the past six months, it added these positions, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and operational first cell, a second Komatsu agreement and cell order, and a Metal 7 collaboration agreement.
